'''Nellow''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Commander/Legends|commander]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire's]] [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial Military]]. In [[3627 BBY]], she was overseeing a team of [[Imperial soldier]]s doing surveillance around the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Iziz/Legends|Iziz]] on [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]] when she was tracked and eliminated by a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] individual.
